resources.string: Allows MIM to immediately turn off and lock your screen when you tap the virtual Power button. MIM never wipes data or monitors other apps.
MIM needs Device Administrator (Screen Lock only) permission so the center Power button can turn off your display and lock your phone immediately.

Used exclusively to lock the screen via Android GLOBAL_ACTION_LOCK_SCREEN when you tap the MIM Power button. Keeps fingerprint and face unlock working on Android 9+. MIM does not read screen content or track other apps.
Keeps the optional MIM floating virtual button controller active when enabled.
Tap to open MIM settings or disable the floating controller.
